title: Product of dual Walsh characters
statement: Let $V$ be an additive commutative group and a vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$. For any two linear functionals $\psi,\phi:V\to\mathbb{F}_2$, the pointwise product of their real-valued Walsh characters is the Walsh character associated with $\psi+\phi$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-module
